preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract.

exploit_hint: The attacker, acting as the contract owner, should call the `setMaxTxPercent` function with the `maxTxPercent` argument set to 0. This action will set the `_maxTxAmount` state variable to zero, effectively halting all transfers between non-owner accounts because the transfer amount will always fail the `amount <= _maxTxAmount` check.
